come.speaker: sorrel
come.text: Come, little one. Sit in the sun while it lasts.

river.speaker: sorrel
river.text: Did I ever tell you about the summer the river ran dry?

stones.speaker: sorrel
stones.text: Stones where the water should be. Fish gasping in the mud. We were all so hungry.

grandmother.speaker: sorrel
grandmother.text: Your grandmother walked three nights to find a spring in the high rocks. She came back with nothing but wet paws... and a path.

walk_first.speaker: sorrel
walk_first.text: Tomorrow you walk the edge for the first time. Remember: we eat because someone walked first.

thanks.speaker: sorrel
thanks.text: A vole? For me? ...You remembered the old way. That warms these bones more than the sun.

empty_pile.speaker: sorrel
empty_pile.text: The pile's empty, I see. No matter. Old bellies learn patience.

dozing.speaker: sorrel
dozing.text: Mm... I'm only dozing. Go on.
